newsitem.title: GERMANY: D.Telekom seen bidding for Retevision.
newsitem.headline: D.Telekom seen bidding for Retevision.

text.p: German telecommunications group Deutsche Telekom AG (DT) on Monday would neither confirm nor deny reports that it planned to bid together with France Telecom for a stake in Spanish telecoms firm Retevision SA.

According to a report in the daily Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung newspaper, a bid for Retevision could also be made by Global One, the international telecommunications venture of DT, France Telecom and Sprint Corp of the United States.
A spokesman for DT would not confirm the report.
"Spain is an interesting market and we are observing it together," he said, referring to France Telecom, but calling the newspaper report "exagerrated".
The Spanish government is planning to privatise Retevision, which operates cable television, digital radio and satellite communications services.
The newspaper report said the most likely candidate for a stake in Retevision was a consortium forming in Spain that would include Banco Santander, Banco Central Hispano, energy group Endesa.
An as yet undefined foreign telecommunications consortium is also expected to join the group, the paper added.
In addition to Deutsche Telekom, which will officially open its Madrid offices on Tuesday, British Telecom and Cable and Wireless.
The FAZ said between 51 percent and 60 percent of Retevision could be sold off next year in the first phase of privatisation.
